claims.statement: The profile-sensitive rank inequality holds at every strict descent for all arity-2/3/4 profiles with 1<=m<=45.
claims.scope: Finite exact integer convolution over all 17,295 count triples and all 938,431 strict descent positions, including zero-extended positions.
claims.reason: Independent replay found no violation; minimum slack is 44. This finite computation alone has no universal force.

claims.scope: All ordinary arity-2/3/4 profiles; polynomial identity over integers, with zero-extended coefficients. The stronger nonnegative-coefficient cone test at all rank-forbidden positions is not part of this valid identity and is refuted at (a2,a3,a4)=(0,0,2), k=3.
claims.reason: Product differentiation proves the identity. The exact obstruction has Delta_3 P=120>0, so it refutes only the stronger cone route, not the identity or rank predicate.

claims.statement: For every ordinary arity-2/3/4 path-star profile, every strict descent k of the actual zero-extended parent P=G product_i B_(r_i)+zL^(N+1) satisfies 54k>=24N-4a2-3a3-5, equivalently 9k+1-4N+h>0 for h=(2/3)a2+(1/2)a3.
claims.scope: All m>=1, all branch count profiles and every natural strict descent of the actual parent polynomial, including its actual least strict descent x and terminal zero-extended descent. This is a parent rank bound only; it does not establish selectors, MASS, or payment. Any eligible p still has x+2<=p, 3p<2alpha+1, 2p<=alpha, j=p-2, and the original strict current-p selector flags and tag multiplicities.
claims.reason: An all-profile coefficientwise differential-operator proof is given in the report. It is informal and independently checked; no formal award is claimed.

claims.statement: At fixed m and N, every strict descent k of the actual parent satisfies 9k+1-4N+hmax(m,N)>0, where hmax=2m-N/2 if N>=3m and hmax=m-N/6 if N<=3m.
claims.scope: All ordinary profiles with m>=1 and every strict descent k; follows from the profile-sensitive rank proof and maximizing h=(2/3)a2+(1/2)a3 subject to fixed m,N. It is a rank relaxation only and does not imply selection or compensation.
claims.reason: Writing d=4m-N=2a2+a3 gives h=d/2-a2/3 and a2>=max(0,3m-N); substitution gives the stated two cases.

limitations: The universal rank proof is informal, not Lean-verified.
The rank claim gives no selector, MASS, or payment result; all eligible-rank guards and current-p flags remain separate.
The bounded scan is corroboration only and is limited to m<=45.
